entities.name: Khwarazmian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Khwarazmian Empire, a political institution in Kazakhstan during Mongol Conquest and Golden Horde (1218–1260). Grew from Kazakh steppe divided between the Golden Horde (Jochi ulus) and Chagatai Khanate. Led to the emergence of Genghis Khan and Mongol forces destroy Otrar after the massacre of Genghis Khan's trade envoys.
